note: MVP baseline rules. Provision text MUST be verified against the official RERA Act and state rules by a person before any public launch (PRD: Verify before launch). This file is a starting set of 8 rules; the PRD target is 20-25 for one state.

rules.ask_en: Ask the builder to remove the grace period.
rules.ask_hi: Builder se grace period hatane ko kaho.
rules.provision: RERA s.18 (text to be verified against the Act)
rules.title_en: Possession date can slip by 18 months
rules.title_hi: Possession date 18 mahine khisak sakti hai

rules.ask_en: Ask the builder to lower the buyer late-payment rate.
rules.ask_hi: Builder se buyer late-payment rate kam karne ko kaho.
rules.provision: RERA s.19 / state rules (text to be verified)
rules.title_en: You pay a high rate on late dues
rules.title_hi: Late payment par aapko zyada rate dena hoga

rules.ask_en: Ask for the same interest rate on both sides.
rules.ask_hi: Dono taraf ek hi interest rate maango.
rules.provision: RERA s.18 / s.19 (text to be verified)
rules.title_en: You pay more on delays than the builder pays you
rules.title_hi: Aap builder se zyada jurmana doge

rules.ask_en: Ask that RERA remedies stay available to you.
rules.ask_hi: Poochho ki RERA wale upay aapke liye khule rahein.
rules.provision: RERA s.31 / s.71 (text to be verified)

rules.ask_en: Ask the builder to state one fixed possession date.
rules.ask_hi: Builder se ek fixed possession date likhwane ko kaho.
rules.provision: Agreement should state possession date (to be verified)

rules.ask_en: Ask the builder to state the total price in figures.
rules.ask_hi: Builder se total price ankon mein likhwane ko kaho.
rules.provision: Agreement should state total consideration (to be verified)
rules.title_hi: Total price saaf taur par nahi likhi hai

rules.ask_en: Ask the builder to state the carpet area in sq ft.
rules.ask_hi: Builder se carpet area sq ft mein likhwane ko kaho.
rules.provision: RERA s.2(k) carpet area definition (to be verified)
rules.title_hi: Carpet area saaf taur par nahi likha hai

rules.ask_en: No action needed on this check.
rules.ask_hi: Is check par koi action zaroori nahi hai.
rules.title_en: No grace period past the possession date
rules.title_hi: Possession date ke baad koi grace period nahi hai
